update.comment: 2.0.0: runs anywhere in CONUS. P1 builds the zone grid from a 30 m DEM on the national lattice, rasterizes fire zones from the national pyrome shapefile, and builds the fire-age map from MTBS mosaics and interagency perimeters; P5 uses each station time zone; C7 takes a 30 m WRC benchmark. Data Sources InteragencyPerimeterFile and WeatherZoneBoundaryFile; Wind Table Options TimeZone; every project gets all 128 CONUS pyromes in Fire Zones.

action.item: ALTER TABLE lucasFireC2F_DataSource ADD COLUMN InteragencyPerimeterFile TEXT
ALTER TABLE lucasFireC2F_DataSource ADD COLUMN WeatherZoneBoundaryFile TEXT
ALTER TABLE lucasFireC2F_WindTableOption ADD COLUMN TimeZone TEXT
